title: The Archive
goalText: File the misfiled block last and put a copy of the atlases in the gap by the door.

hints: `dap` deletes the shelf you stand in and the empty row after it. `}` jumps to the next empty row; `p` puts the shelf below.
`yip` copies a shelf without its empty row. Count up with `6k`, then `G` and `k` to the gap by the door.
The gap already has empty rows on both sides: `P` above it keeps both. `yap` would bring a third one.
